name: RGB vegetation proxy (Excess Green)
description: Excess Green index from the chromatic coordinates of the true-color bands: an RGB proxy for green vegetation cover, not NDVI, because the scene has no near-infrared band.
formula: ExG = 2g - r - b, where r = R/(R+G+B), g = G/(R+G+B), b = B/(R+G+B)
citation: Woebbecke, D.M., Meyer, G.E., Von Bargen, K., Mortensen, D.A. (1995). Color indices for weed identification under various soil, residue, and lighting conditions. Transactions of the ASAE 38(1).
compute_values_source:
def compute_values(bands, params):
    """Excess Green on chromatic coordinates; undefined where R+G+B is zero."""
    total = bands["red"] + bands["green"] + bands["blue"]
    safe = np.where(total > 0, total, np.nan)
    r = bands["red"] / safe
    g = bands["green"] / safe
    b = bands["blue"] / safe
    return 2 * g - r - b

next_steps.description: Inspect the largest strong-green region in the source image to confirm it is vegetation rather than green-tinted water or shadow.
When a scene with a near-infrared band is available, compute NDVI and compare it with this RGB proxy.
